body.x: E-vone presented smart shoes with drop detector and warning functions at 'CES 2018 Unveiled' in 7th of January in Las Vegas, United States.

E-vone, a French company, made smart shoes for the elderly, workers and travellers. These smart shoes use a device at the sole of the shoe to detect drops or abnormal movements. As soon as the movements are detected, a message will be sent to the emergency contact of the elderly or the emergency service centre. The shoes feature a gyroscope and an accelerometer for the motion sensor as well as a GSM that can communicate in about 120 countries and a GPS for the location.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
